description: For every Boolean row on a finite ground atom set, the row problem's subterm support is exactly the union of those atoms' subterm sets, independent of their signs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem_support.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L))
  (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L → Bool) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem S b) =
    S.biUnion Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom.subterms
